sample: LEGA-C DR2 quiescent test set, 10 galaxies
selection: Eligible: 122 of the 187 matched in COSMOS2025 with warn-flag = 0, and COSMOS2020 Classic FlagCOMBINED = 0 so cosmos2025_uv also runs.
Kept M1_210210; added the extremes of S/N, z, sigma*, mass, age and tau_dust, u* residuals, the most significant Balmer emission, and the worst chi2/N, f_calib, [alpha/Fe] and Borghi+22 cases.
Preferred galaxies that cover several cases and the calibration-order reference galaxies.

sources.z, sn, sigma_star_kms, emission EW: LEGA-C DR2 z, SN (overall median S/N per pixel), SIGMA_STARS_PRIME, Hb/Hg/Hd_EW (negative in emission); data/raw/legac_dr2/VizieR_ReadMe.txt
sources.logmass, age_gyr, tau_dust, joint_chi2_p: posterior medians and diagnostics of the 187 fits (7 SFH bins, order-3 calibration, cosmos_total photometry, tau_dust Uniform(0, 2)); results/dr2-quiescent-new-defaults-summary.csv, results/per-galaxy-diagnostics.csv
sources.COSMOS2025: Shuntov et al. (2025), VizieR J/A+A/704/A339/phot, 1 arcsec match; data/raw/cosmos2025/README.md
sources.COSMOS2020 Classic: Weaver et al. (2022), VizieR J/ApJS/258/11/classic; data/raw/cosmos2020/README.md
sources.Borghi+22: Borghi et al. (2022), ApJ 927, 164, Table 4 ages; data/processed/borghi2022_legac_dr2/

targets.reason: Highest S/N and lowest z of the 187; young; large u* and B residuals (pulls -3.3, -5.6); calibration-order reference.
Youngest of the 187; HdeltaA 6.5 A, D4000n 1.44; low mass; u* above the model (pull +6.9).
Most significant Balmer emission in the footprint: Hdelta EW -1.83 +/- 0.17 A, Hgamma -1.30 +/- 0.22 A, Hbeta -0.43 +/- 0.17 A; low sigma*; in the 2026-09-22 diagnostic set.
Highest sigma* in the footprint; high mass; [alpha/Fe] at the grid lower edge (-0.2); calibration-order reference; Borghi+22 overlap.
Lowest tau_dust of the 187 and old; joint chi2/N 1.71 with f_calib at its prior bound.
Worst joint chi2/N of the 187 (spectrum 2.68, 82 pixels with |pull| > 4); f_calib at its prior bound; low mass.
Largest Ceridwen minus Borghi+22 age difference among eligible footprint galaxies (4.72 vs 1.75 Gyr).
Highest z in the footprint; low S/N; joint chi2/N 1.55 with f_calib at its 10% prior bound; calibration-order reference.
Dusty (tau_dust 1.36, above the current Uniform(0, 1) bound); S/N 3.7, second-lowest of the 187; z 0.89; high mass.
